headline: 69.5/100 — major reconstruction required
summary: Against the supplied 425 body pages, this delivered index is useful in places but not publication-ready; its 69.5/100 score and seven failed standard gates require major reconstruction.

grade.label: Weak finished index; major reconstruction required.

scorecard.label: Meaningful coverage
scorecard.rationale: Weighted benchmark access is 49.8% complete, 40.1% partial, and 10.1% missing; 12 of 155 essential subjects are missing.
scorecard.question: Does it include what matters?

scorecard.label: Editorial selectivity
scorecard.rationale: Of 5,338 locators, 4,643 are fully supported, 232 partially supported, and 463 unsupported; 235 attribution/example/citation-clutter locators occur across all 17 chapters. The frozen density fit is 3.0/5.
scorecard.question: Does it leave out what does not belong?

scorecard.label: Conceptual and stance fidelity
scorecard.rationale: Conceptual/stance review passes 1,852 of 1,904 nodes, but records 37 major issues, 5 failures, and three explicit major stance defects.
scorecard.question: Does it represent the book accurately?

scorecard.label: Page-reference reliability
scorecard.rationale: The strict supported-locator rate is 87.0% and treatment recall is 92.9%; 463 unsupported assignments occur in every chapter.
scorecard.question: Does it point to the right pages?

scorecard.label: Findability and navigation
scorecard.rationale: Only 500 of 1,026 reader tasks fully succeed, while 443 partly succeed and 83 fail; 16 nodes have at least 15 undivided locators and 3 of 16 cross-references are unsupported.
scorecard.question: Can readers find things efficiently?

scorecard.label: Mechanics and consistency
scorecard.rationale: All locators resolve, but 14 visible digit-for-accent substitutions, one redundant page assignment, one out-of-order sequence, and localized name/reference defects require correction.
scorecard.question: Is it professionally consistent?

evaluation_sequence.title: Establish source and scope
evaluation_sequence.description: Verify the exact edition, map source page labels to supplied document pages, and freeze eligible matter and chapter ownership.

evaluation_sequence.title: Discover source subjects candidate-blind
evaluation_sequence.description: Identify substantively treated concepts, arguments, relationships, distinctions, and reader needs from the source before candidate judgment.

evaluation_sequence.title: Synthesize, independently review, and freeze the benchmark
evaluation_sequence.description: Reconcile chapter discoveries, conduct fresh candidate-blind QA over every required benchmark item, then freeze the source denominator and hashes.

evaluation_sequence.title: Audit in both directions
evaluation_sequence.description: Test every candidate path/page assignment against the source, then test every frozen source subject and treatment against the candidate.

evaluation_sequence.title: Audit the index as a navigation system
evaluation_sequence.description: Judge hierarchy, terminology, cross-references, coherence, mechanics, distribution, and chapter-level density before deterministic scoring.

audit_directions.question: Does each proposed complete heading path and cited page belong?
Can readers retrieve every frozen substantive source subject and treatment?
Do individually defensible records form a coherent navigation system?

interpretation_bands.label: Excellent finished index; potentially near publication-ready after full review
Strong index; meaningful editorial review still needed
Weak finished index; major reconstruction required
Poor reader access; not suitable as delivered

score_meaning.gate_rule: A failed applicable critical gate limits publication-readiness claims without changing the arithmetic score.

density_policy.disclosure: Targets are 8 locator-bearing heading paths and 20 locator occurrences per 1,000 indexable source words, measured by chapter as permissive calibration rather than quotas or hard ceilings.

item_grading.popover_contract: Every item exposes grade scope, confidence, factors, weights or caps, public-safe explanations, navigation IDs, and evidence IDs.
item_grading.neutral_rule: Uninspectable and not-measured items are neutral, not failures.

detailed_criteria.title: Scope compliance
questions: Does the audit use only approved, indexable source matter?
Are substantive body text and inspectable eligible notes, captions, quotations, and tables handled consistently?
Are bibliographies, navigation lists, running furniture, proof material, excluded back matter, and other indexes excluded?
Are mixed pages and unavailable matter disclosed rather than silently scored?

detailed_criteria.title: Substantive coverage
questions: Are principal and independently useful subsidiary subjects findable?
Are arguments, findings, causes, consequences, comparisons, distinctions, methods, synthesis, and conclusions represented?
Are important one-off concepts preserved even when they are not frequent terms?
Are principal, supporting, and conclusion-level treatment pages represented proportionately?

detailed_criteria.title: Editorial selectivity
questions: Does every locator-bearing path represent substantive treatment?
Are passing mentions, citation-only names, attribution-only scholars, and incidental entities excluded?
Are examples indexed independently only when sustained, analytically important, or useful to retrieve?
Does the index avoid concordance-like repetition, redundant access, trivial subdivisions, and material density mismatch?

detailed_criteria.title: Conceptual and stance fidelity
questions: Does each heading accurately describe the source?
Are supported, proposed, possible, questioned, qualified, rejected, inconclusive, and reported claims distinguished?
Are different subjects, periods, senses, scopes, explanations, and findings kept distinct?
Do broad or compound headings avoid claiming more than every cited page supports?

detailed_criteria.title: Heading and access architecture
questions: Are headings concise, specific, reader-oriented, and independently searchable?
Are synonyms consolidated and materially different senses distinguished?
Does each path remain within the permitted two-level hierarchy?
Do subdivisions express useful concepts rather than merely page or section divisions?
Are important subjects given intuitive direct or valid cross-referenced access rather than buried beneath vague umbrellas?

detailed_criteria.title: Locator quality
questions: Does each cited page substantively support the complete heading path?
Are principal, continuation, comparison, synthesis, and conclusion pages included?
Is every page in a displayed range evaluated independently?
Are locators valid, unique, ordered, and resolved to indexable source pages?

detailed_criteria.title: Compound-heading scope
questions: Does every locator support every component asserted by a compound heading?
Have component-specific locators been combined under an unsupported relationship?
Are distinct treatments split when needed without losing stance, chronology, scope, or explanation?

detailed_criteria.title: Cross-references
questions: Does each see reference represent a plausible equivalent access term?
Does each see-also reference connect distinct indexed subjects usefully?
Does every target resolve exactly or deterministically?
Are self-references, cycles, chained see references, misleading links, and excessive reference webs absent?

detailed_criteria.title: Whole-index coherence
questions: Is one reader concept kept from fragmenting across competing headings?
Are parallel subjects organized and worded consistently?
Does the index balance specificity with coherent grouping?
Is coverage proportionate rather than dominated by repeated terminology, names, or examples?

detailed_criteria.title: Mechanical validity
questions: Does every page-bearing entry have one unique permitted path and at least one valid locator?
Are duplicate paths and locator occurrences removed and page references ordered?
Are cross-reference types and targets valid and deduplicated?
Are empty entries, invalid records, and third-level headings absent?
Does the completed result conform to the required schemas?

methodology.uncertainty_policy: Record uncertainty explicitly; adjudicate every critical, major, and uncertain item; exclude uninspectable locators from precision denominators and disclose them.
methodology.evidence_policy: Public display uses concise paraphrases and stable evidence IDs; exact or extended source text remains outside the public payload.

comparison_key.uncertainty_policy: Record uncertainty explicitly; adjudicate every critical, major, and uncertain item; exclude uninspectable locators from precision denominators and disclose them.

comparability.rule: Another candidate is directly comparable only when every frozen comparison-key field matches.

disclosures: The 69.5/100 total is a weighted quality summary, not a percentage correct.
Publication-readiness gates are reported separately and are not hidden arithmetic penalties.
The source benchmark was discovered, independently reviewed, and frozen with candidate blindness preserved; no competing index was treated as ground truth.
The audit is full and complete for the supplied 425 body pages and the delivered 25-page candidate representation.
Item grades are diagnostic display summaries derived from frozen evidence. They do not add to or replace the six-dimension 100-point rubric. Not-measured items are neutral, not failures.
Targets are 8 locator-bearing heading paths and 20 locator occurrences per 1,000 indexable source words, measured by chapter as permissive calibration rather than quotas or hard ceilings.
Colors are semantic tokens supplied by each item grade and must always be paired with a text label or icon; keyboard focus and touch expose the same popover as hover.
Representative examples use public-safe paraphrases and frozen evidence IDs rather than extended source quotation.
limitations: The supplied source contains document pages 1-425 of the body only; front matter, notes/endnotes, bibliography, and the publisher index were absent and therefore excluded under the frozen policy.

The delivered candidate is an IndexerLabs-distributed, ReportLab-rendered representation, not an independently verified authoritative OUP scan; delivered OCR/encoding defects were preserved and scored.

Seven localized, high-confidence conflicts between frozen benchmark treatment classifications and canonical locator judgments were retained without reinterpretation and disclosed for centralized adjudication; none was classified as critical or major unresolved grounding.
Density targets are this framework's permissive standardized calibration values, not universal professional quotas or hard limits.

evidence_index.resolution_disclosure: Every displayed conclusion carries stable evidence IDs. Routes identify the frozen artifact and collection used for optional inspection; public views should resolve only fields authorized for disclosure.
